title: Zesty Grilled Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A romantic Syrian dish featuring lamb kebabs marinated in a mixture of wine, kosher salt, and kombu-cold-extract, grilled to perfection on a binchotan grill. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together red wine, kosher salt, kombu-cold-extract, and olive oil to make the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and season with garlic and black pepper.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as grilled vegetables or couscous.
